items.name: FitTrack Pro Smart Watch — GPS, Heart Rate, 5ATM Water Resistant

orderRecord.orderNotes: In-store purchase. Chip transaction processed correctly with full EMV data. Cardholder returned [5 days later] claiming defects. Store staff tested the watch — heart rate sensor worked during the test. Staff recommended a firmware update. Cardholder left with the watch and did not initiate a return.
